gaps.what: Extent of the 143,044 km2 outline (750-1187) and the 1188 drop to 54,786 km2 are unverified; the 1188 loss to the Khmer Empire and the 1082 end of the dependency of Lavo are confidence 1.
Seshat page th_haribhunjaya_k not read (would give Cliopatria's source for the 661 start and the outline).

Extent of Lavo in 1241-1351 (42,717 km2), the southern bulge of the 1056/1066 shapes, the 1375 strip (confidence 1) and the date of the Khmer conquest (946/1001/c.1005/1006/1011-1014) are not settled by the pages.
The Lavo Kingdom page's infobox and succession table are garbled (capitals, rulers, predecessors/successors); capitals follow the infobox and the Ayutthaya page; no rulers strip.
Seshat pages th_lavo_k_1 and th_lavo_k_2 not opened.
No page gives a frontier or an area; the Funan annexation is dated only as the span 627-649 (627 used); Isanavarman's reign and Isanapura's founder conflict on the page; Seshat kh_chenla not opened.
Capital disputed on the page (Pelliot, Coedes, Hoshino); nothing dated between the 798 mission and 802; no formal unification with the Khmer Empire described.

Pages disagree on whether Water Chenla ended c. 790 (Chenla page) or survived to 802 as a Javanese vassal under Jayavarman II (Jayavarman II page); capital unlocated; the Javanese power (Srivijaya or Mataram) not settled.

problems: Chenla, Land Chenla and Water Chenla (one Wikidata id) were judged one state that divided c. 707 and written as three dossiers (chenla 550-707, land-chenla 707-802, water-chenla 707-790); they can be merged under chenla if reviewers prefer. Years moved from Cliopatria: Chenla start 550 (555), Funan annexed from 627 (641), split c. 707 (718), Land Chenla end 802 (805), Water Chenla end 790 (805).

Lavo Kingdom kept as one state (not split): the page treats it as one mandala 648-1388; Haripunjaya kept as one state with start moved to c. 750 (the page's 'more probable' founding; Cliopatria 661 is the chronicle date; the 750 is marked [citation needed] on the page).

Page budget: 12 distinct pages opened (Chenla, Lavo, Haripunjaya, Mangrai, Dvaravati, Jayavarman II, Khmer Empire, Ayutthaya, Pagan, Sukhothai, Funan, Champa); sources_total 22 counts source entries across the five dossiers, shared pages counted once per dossier. Lavo lists six pages against a budget of five (Haripunjaya page added for the 1052 annexation).
Resolve warnings in lavo-kingdom (3) and haripunjaya (1) are counterpart slugs with no dossier (dvaravati, tambralinga); no region name failed to resolve.
Area comparison was mostly impossible: the Chenla and Haripunjaya pages give no km2 figure; Lavo's infobox 170,000 km2 is undated (ratio 0.74-0.84 for 638-1187 shapes, 0.25 for the 1241-1351 shape).
Only the Seshat page th_haribhunjaya_k was tried and failed to load; no WebFetch retries were needed for Wikipedia pages.
